themes.name: [Negative] Misleading Cashback & US Stock Requirement

quotes.text: very poor app, misguide about his reward money back ,first shown that if u will pay your post paid bill app reward 25/ after 10 payment of postpaid bill he assured you will get 500/ extra ,but sorry to see that all payments credited in US reward amount ,when you will purchase us equity then u can get how reward amount ,also all money back transferd in us reward points ,this shows misleading to consumer ,very poor app about bill payment and UPI payment
You have to mandatorily create us stocks account and buy 5000 in us stocks to claim the cashback earned in bill payments or upi payments. which is ridiculous.
I paid my postpaid bill and got cashback in hs stocks lol. I am not buying any of us stocks! And while paying the bill it didn't mention that where exactly you will get the cashback.
no use of cashback forcefully asking to create a us stock account which is terrible...before we used to claim cashback for recharge
There is bug in the app, when we press on cashback under UPI & bills section we jump to us stock page.

themes.description: Users report that the app’s advertised cashback for bill and UPI payments actually redirects to US stock purchases, with rewards credited as stock points instead of cash or clear rewards, and requires users to open a US‑stocks account and meet investment thresholds that are not disclosed upfront.
themes.business_impact: The misleading promise drives negative reviews, erodes user trust, increases churn, and could expose the company to regulatory scrutiny over deceptive advertising, ultimately reducing paid‑user acquisition and retention.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The reward engine is incorrectly wired to the US‑stock investment product, and the user flow fails to surface this requirement, leading to a perceived “cashback” that is actually a stock incentive; coupled with poor UI messaging and a broken navigation flow.
themes.action_plan:
• Clarify reward terms in all payment flows
• Remove mandatory US‑stock account requirement for cashback
• Re‑implement a true cash or redeemable reward mechanism
• Update UI to clearly label rewards as stock points if still offered
• Fix navigation bug that sends users to US‑stock page from cashback button
• Conduct audit of reward logic and policy
• Roll out change with user education and support response
• Monitor metrics for churn and review sentiment
• Update legal compliance documentation

themes.description: Users report inconsistent and rising brokerage and MTF rates with no clear disclosure, leading to distrust and the perception of hidden fees.
themes.business_impact: Customers are switching to competitor brokers, resulting in measurable churn, lost revenue, brand damage, and increased risk of regulatory scrutiny over opaque fee practices.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: A fragmented pricing strategy combined with reactive fee adjustments driven by market conditions, without standardized rates or transparent communication channels, is causing the perceived unfairness.
themes.action_plan:
• 1. Conduct a comprehensive audit of current fee structures to identify inconsistencies.
• 2. Standardize brokerage and MTF rates across all users.
• 3. Implement a transparent fee disclosure module in the app and website.
• 4. Create a communication rollout plan to inform users of any future changes with at least 30 days notice.
• 5. Revise customer support scripts and train agents on transparency policies.
• 6. Establish a fee change governance committee involving Finance, Product, and Legal.
• 7. Monitor post‑implementation feedback and adjust as needed.
